static_identity_only_rule: Only static identity fields (codes, names, coordinates, operator, zone) are eligible for offline bundling. Live schedule, platform assignment, gate, delay, PNR, and real-time status are ALWAYS NETWORK_REQUIRED and must never be bundled.

datasets.authority: NTES / Indian Railways official station master data
datasets.change_trigger: IRCTC zone/division restructure or station renaming gazette
datasets.attribution_text: National Train Enquiry System (NTES) — Indian Railways

datasets.authority: AAI — Airports Authority of India; ICAO/IATA official designators
datasets.change_trigger: AAI gazette notification for new airport opening or IATA code change

hard_invariants: Live schedule data is NEVER bundled — always fetch from NTES/IndiaRail APIs at runtime.
Platform, gate, delay, PNR lookup are ALWAYS NETWORK_REQUIRED.
Station and airport codes are stable identifiers; bundle with 180-day stale label policy.
Feeder bus linkages (if any) must be sourced from CRUT canonical data, not inferred.
